changelog.title: Collapsible Lab Instructions
changelog.description: Instructions panel in Core 2 hands-on labs can now be collapsed to free up workspace, with auto-expand on task switch.

changelog.title: Content Assignments
changelog.description: Handlers can assign learning paths or individual items to classes with optional due dates and notes.

changelog.title: Content Browser
changelog.description: Full-screen content browser with tabs for Learning Paths and Individual Items, filterable by house, type, difficulty, and search.
